mapper.select: SELECT user_id, base_url, api_key_ciphertext FROM mf_ai_credential WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_ai_credential (user_id, base_url, api_key_ciphertext) VALUES (#{userId}, #{baseUrl}, #{ciphertext}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_url = VALUES(base_url), api_key_ciphertext = VALUES(api_key_ciphertext), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE mf_ai_credential SET api_key_ciphertext = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
